description: This file defines a controller class 'RestoreDatabaseToSavepointController' responsible for handling HTTP requests to restore a database to a specific savepoint during functional testing in the OrangeHRM project. It implements an interface for public controllers and interacts with a database backup service to perform the restore operation, returning a JSON response with the count of tables restored.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointController
classes.description: A controller class that handles HTTP requests to restore a database to a specified savepoint during functional testing. It retrieves the savepoint name from the request, calls the backup service to perform the restore, and returns the count of affected tables in a JSON response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming HTTP request, retrieves the savepoint name, invokes the database restore, and constructs the JSON response with the number of tables restored.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming request to restore database to a savepoint, retrieves the savepoint name from request parameters, calls the backup service to restore, and returns a JSON response with the number of affected tables.
